name: Web and office password minimum length setting and default
summary: The installation's password minimum is configurable from 1 to 1024 characters (--password-min-length N on http_service.py and password_min_length in office.json) and defaults to DEFAULT_PASSWORD_MIN = 5 (kittrial-5bb.547). Values outside 1..1024 or non-integers are refused at startup without clamping. Stored password verifiers keep working regardless of length; the minimum applies when a password is set via bootstrap, password change, or reset redemption.
